notes: The manual is only pictures, so exact stud-to-stud ports are mostly left null. Connectivity (which piece sits on or against which) is inferred from the step images.
Only Donald Duck (40377) has build steps. Page 34 is a cover for the Pluto and Goofy set, with no steps, so it is not modelled.

The head ring (b33-b38, b43-b48) and the four side panels are approximate. Which grey side-stud brick carries which plate, tile or face piece (b52, b68, b71, b72, b53-b58) is guessed from the pictures. The parts and the joined plate/tile relationships are correct.
Steps 2-3: the exact pairing of the four white corner plates around the bracket is approximate. The bracket and slope are modelled as joined, with plates stacked on them.
Step 19 beak: the curved bricks b61 and b62 are shown joined to the white plate b59. The orange tile b60 is shown on the orange plate b63. The picture does not make the exact fit clear.
Steps 24-25: the feet are modelled as orange plate pairs plus wedges. In step 29 the wedges stand on the two studs of b90, so they are joined to it.
The eye tiles b64 and b65 are placed on the studs of b58 (lego-41740), assuming the eyes sit at its two outer studs.
The hat's clip plate b81 is joined to the black round plate, since it is a separate piece from the 1x3 plate. The black handle plate b85 clips onto b81 (bar into clip).
Step 7 gives only the plate+brick pairs. The gray 22885 bricks are assumed to have their 4-stud side facing outward, so the blue and white side plates attach to their side studs.
